$description:
Track contract — the RECESSED rail that holds raised cells/thumbs
(segmented-control track, slider rail, tabs list). Distinct from FIELD (holds
text, not interactive cells) and from CONTROL (raised). The ACTIVE cell/thumb
that rides in the track reuses the CONTROL contract (e.g. the segmented
indicator reads --a63-control-shadow); the track itself is the sunken well.

Lean by design (see the taxonomy spec): semantics carry the default look — the
recipe reads --a63-surface-control (bg), --a63-control-radius (radius) and its
inset/gap constants at the use-site. The ONE thing themes vary distinctly for a
recessed rail is its INSET-WELL depth, so that is the only contract token here.

--a63-track-shadow is a static inset (mode-independent, like --a63-field-shadow),
so it's safe to default at :root and let each theme override it on its shell
(modern faint inset, aqua deeper sunken gel, retro Win98 inset well, terminal
faint phosphor inset).

NOTE: the joined-ToggleGroup bar is intentionally a RAISED control (it reads the
CONTROL contract — aqua gel / retro bevel), NOT a track. "Segmented set" has two
valid archetype expressions: recessed-well (SegmentedControl) vs raised-bar
(joined ToggleGroup). Only the recessed one is `track`.
